verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a real-time communications platform that handles media and recordings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only automatic Anycast routing to the nearest Cloudflare location, which is the opposite of user-chosen residency. Nothing documents choosing a storage region for recordings, transcripts or other data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
